risks.title: SMSF advice and guarantees not fully evidenced
risks.message: The borrower is an SMSF. The application confirms an LRBA and a bare trust, but says only that the members 'have received advice from their accountant'. §2.4 requires independent legal and financial advice. Nothing shows legal advice was obtained, or that the accountant is independent. Personal guarantees from the fund members, which §2.4 expects, are not mentioned.

risks.title: Refinance exit not supported
risks.message: The exit is 'repayment from fund contributions and rental income, then refinance'. Refinance appears to be the main repayment route at the end of the 36-month term, but nothing shows the loan would meet a mainstream lender's criteria then. This matters more for an SMSF borrower under an LRBA. No figures are given for the fund's contributions or the rental income.

risks.title: Exit likely relies on a single retail tenancy
risks.message: The security is a single shop (Shop 2), and the exit relies partly on rental income. That suggests dependence on one tenant. The application gives no tenant name, lease terms, remaining lease term or tenant strength, so this dependence is unexplained.
